newsitem.title: USA: Ahmanson sues Great Western over shareholder vote.
newsitem.headline: Ahmanson sues Great Western over shareholder vote.

text.p: H.F. Ahmanson & Co Wednesday sued its takeover target Great Western Financial Corp seeking to "determine the validity of (a) stockholder vote", according to information papers filed in the Delaware Chancery Court.

The lawsuit was filed hours after Great Western said the results of a consent solicitation vote on three Ahmanson- sponsored shareholder proposals would not be released until they had been tabulated by an independent inspector of elections.
The complaint document itself is not available from the court, but in the information papers filed, Ahmanson said it had submitted the consents to Great Western on Wednesday.

In a statement earlier on Wednesday, Ahmanson said it had received consents for a majority of shares on its proposals to hold an annual meeting by May 6; to prohibit adjournment of a shareholder meeting with a quorum until all business brought before the meeting had been acted on; and to prohibit the Great Western board from amending by-law amendments pursuant to Ahmanson's consent solicitation without prior approval by shareholders.
Great Western said it remains committed to its merger agreement with Washington Mutual Inc announced March 6. The lawsuit seeks expedited proceedings but no injunctive relief.
No other information about the lawsuit is available at this time.
